throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.init: addi.d $r20, $sp, -1024; li.d $r4, 0x3ff0000000000000; movgr2fr.d $f0, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f1, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f2, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f3, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f4, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f5, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f6, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f7, $r4
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 5 --core 0 --init 'addi.d $r20, $sp, -1024; li.d $r4, 0x3ff0000000000000; movgr2fr.d $f0, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f1, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f2, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f3, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f4, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f5, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f6, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f7, $r4' --asm 'fst.s $f0, $r20, 0; fst.s $f1, $r20, 8; fst.s $f2, $r20, 16; fst.s $f3, $r20, 24; fst.s $f4, $r20, 32; fst.s $f5, $r20, 40; fst.s $f6, $r20, 48; fst.s $f7, $r20, 56'

notes: No destination data dependency; latency is not defined. Throughput only.
